title: Capability: event-anchored cooldowns and soft-limit safe-use costs for magic items
description: Selected under the user's 2026-10-12 rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): this structure stays TYPED in the SRD pack because a positive engine capability is more likely than not in the near future, so the capability must exist before the re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14). Capability contract per ADR 0020 / eshyra-olc5: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real binding to the pack fields, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed for unsupported input. Pack shape is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (PR #656); coordinate field shapes with it rather than changing the pack later. Scope: item economies whose wait starts at a printed termination event rather than at activation (Ring of Djinni Summoning: 24 hours after the djinni departs; Wings of Flying: 1d12 hours after the wings disappear; Efreeti Bottle stopper sequence; and any sibling found by the #656 sweep). Extend usageCounters/itemState/itemResetExecutor so availableAt is scheduled from the anchoring event, with full/early-termination and nonzero-elapsed scenarios. Initiation-anchored cooldowns (Frost Brand, Horn of Valhalla) keep current behaviour.
notes:
STOP CONDITION (user, 2026-10-12): if any KEPT-typed category (economies incl. event anchors, action type, structured equipment prerequisites, kept state machines/duration toggles, grant creature/count/duration/reversion) or any capability bead eshyra-olc5.8-.12 turns out to be particularly difficult to verify in a way that makes convergence unlikely (e.g. repeated review findings in the same kept category, or verification that cannot distinguish faithful from unfaithful cheaply), the captain must SURFACE it to the user with evidence before proceeding - do not keep repairing it and do not silently reclassify it as DM-adjudicated.
EXTENDED 2026-10-13 (user, S3 of review 19.4.6.7): soft-limit operation costs - a printed count of risk-free uses (Ring of X-ray Vision before a long rest; Wind Fan before dawn) spends a safe use while one remains; when none remain the operation is still permitted (no hard refusal) and the printed risk (DC 15 Con save or exhaustion; cumulative 20% tear) is DM-adjudicated. Bind to the soft-limit marker on the operation cost entry introduced by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.
